dogecoin.text: @IamDavidBrain @Polkadot Haha, I was Googling dogs to buy and saw the Dogecoin image on a price chart! I’m so used to seeing investment prices linked to serious things, so seeing a dog’s face representing actual money really sparked my curiosity. 😹

@Polkadot I didn’t choose Web3, back in 2014, I started seeing strange things about Dogecoin. That led me to blockchain. Then I discovered Eth, which planted a seed of change in me. Later I found Polkadot through Dr Gavin Wood. It wasn’t a choice , just a natural shift towards freedom.
